		limit = {
			COLDWAR_KOR_can_reform_party_accounts = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_reform_party_accounts_paid }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_reform_party_accounts_party_finance_interest_rate_multiplier_modifier = -0.2 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_reform_party_accounts_party_finance_political_power_factor = -0.04 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_reform_party_accounts_party_finance_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.03 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_slot_party_2_reform_party_finance = 213 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_reform_party_accounts_paid
		COLDWAR_KOR_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
}

						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_energy }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_energy }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_energy }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_energy }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_active_start_energy_intermediate = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_energy_intermediate }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_energy_intermediate }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_energy_intermediate }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_energy_intermediate }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_active_start_political_command = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_political_command }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_political_command }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_political_command }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_political_command }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_active_start_social_insurance = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_social_insurance }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_social_insurance }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_social_insurance }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_KOR_start_social_insurance }
			}
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_KOR_add_weekly_programme_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_campaign = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_initialized }
		COLDWAR_KOR_calculate_weekly_cost = yes
		add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = COLDWAR_KOR_weekly_cost }
	}
}
